title: Observability: token-level KV cache metrics, tracing spans, dashboards, and alert tuning
author: Anjali Rao
description: Adds token-level KV cache hit/miss metrics, end-to-end tracing spans for prefix/KV cache lookup and cache population, Grafana dashboard panels for token-level cost/latency breakdowns, and tuned alerts to reduce noise. Motivation: customers and SREs need visibility into per-token cost and latency contributions from cache, batching, and model variants to triage regressions and control unit economics. This PR: 1) emits new metrics: redwood.kv_cache.tokens.total, redwood.kv_cache.tokens.hit, redwood.kv_cache.populate_latency_ms, redwood.inference.token_latency_ms{stage}, redwood.inference.token_cost_tokens, redwood.inference.kv_cache_hit_ratio; 2) adds tracing spans around KV lookup and KV fill and tags spans with cache_hit boolean and sequence positions; 3) dashboard: new panels in observability/grafana/token-level.json for token latency histogram, cost heatmap, KV hit rate over request position, and top queries by token-cost; 4) alert tuning: lower sensitivity on token-latency p95 but add surge alert for token_cost_per_minute and KV populate latency; 5) adds unit and integration tests that simulate KV cache cold starts and warm steady-state and validates metrics emission; 6) rollout plan: feature flag obs.kv_token_metrics rollout 10%->50%->100% with canary dashboards and a 48-hour monitoring window. Checklist: - [x] emit metrics in runtime - [x] tracing spans instrumented - [x] dashboards added - [x] integration tests - [x] alert rules updated - [x] docs updated (observability guide).
